subject: Re: Walkthrough scheduling — timezone label confusion
messages:
From: Marta Kowalski <marta@northlane.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: supri.rao@northlane.com
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 09:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Intro demo — proposing Tue/Thu slots (timezone question)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks for the quick intro yesterday — we're excited to see Redwood Inference in action. I tried to set a calendar slot but noticed the invite defaulted to PST on our side (we're in CET) and a couple of people double-booked. I'm proposing two windows that should work for the core team:

- Thurs 11 Nov, 10:00–10:45 CET
- Fri 12 Nov, 15:00–15:45 CET

Can you confirm whether your invite will publish in CET? I attached a screenshot of what my calendar shows (it displayed 01:00 for a slot you suggested). Also, two stakeholders will be traveling that week (one transatlantic). If those slots don't work we can look at early-morning US-friendly times.

Attachments: northlane-calendar-screenshot.png

Thanks,
Marta Kowalski
Head of Digital Ops
Northlane Retail

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Marta Kowalski <marta@northlane.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Nov 2026 13:15:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposing Tue/Thu slots (timezone question)

Marta — thanks for the note and the screenshot, that makes the issue clear. Apologies for the confusion; our calendar tool defaulted to the account profile which was set to Pacific.

Quick plan:
- I'll send new invites explicitly set to CET and include the event times in CET and UTC in the description.
- Vanessa, could you take point on a calendar reissue and include both Marta and Supriya's personal addresses so traveling attendees get the correct conversion?
- Karthik, please flag whether we should record the session (Northlane consent) and whether the APAC team needs a separate, short follow-up.

Proposed slots (I'm showing both CET / UTC):
- Thu 2026-11-11 10:00 CET / 09:00 UTC
- Fri 2026-11-12 15:00 CET / 14:00 UTC

I've attached a mutual action plan draft to get alignment on objectives and stakeholders. If neither slot works because of travel, we can offer an 07:30 CET slot that lands in US friendly hours.

Attachments: mutual-action-plan-v1.docx

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Supriya Rao <supriya@northlane.com>
To: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: Marta Kowalski <marta@northlane.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 08:05:00 +05:30
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposing Tue/Thu slots (timezone question)

Hi Dylan — quick update from our side. The CET times look fine for most of the team, but one of our leads (Ben) will be on travel and his calendar client auto-converted to EST incorrectly. We ended up with two invites for the same time because Ben accepted the EST invite and Marta accepted the CET one.

Given the travel and a late change in Ben's flight, could we lock the session to the earlier slot (Thu 10:00 CET) and tag it as recorded? That way Ben can watch the recording and we can avoid re-running the same walkthrough twice.

Also, could the calendar invite title include a clear timezone line (e.g., "10:00 CET / 09:00 UTC — session recorded")? Our calendar system parses the title better than the timezone field.

Thanks for sorting this quickly.

— Supriya
Program Manager, Integrations
Northlane Retail

From: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
To: Marta Kowalski <marta@northlane.com>, Supriya Rao <supriya@northlane.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposing Tue/Thu slots (timezone question)

Thanks Supriya and Marta — confirmed. I created a single, definitive invite for Thu 2026-11-11 10:00 CET / 09:00 UTC and explicitly wrote the timezone in the event title and description.

Notes included in the invite:
- Title: "Northlane x Redwood walkthrough — 10:00 CET / 09:00 UTC — recorded"
- Recording: will be enabled; link posted to the event chat post-call
- Meeting assets: mutual-action-plan-v1.docx attached; calendar screenshot archived in the event.
- Request: please accept the updated invite only — delete any earlier duplicates to avoid double-books.

Vanessa added the right set of addresses and flagged a reminder 24 hours prior. Karthik: if APAC needs a separate 30-minute briefing, can you propose times next week?

I've also dropped a short plaintext note clarifying timezone behavior into the event (attached as tz-clarifier.txt) so calendar clients that parse the description will show both local and CET times.

See you Thursday — and Marta, thanks for surfacing the calendar screenshot; that saved us a second run.

Best,
Dylan
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
